text:
sam: Heads-up — new CVE wave for cluster components: kubelet (CVE-2026-1001, priv esc), etcd (CVE-2026-2002, rce), nginx-ingress (CVE-2026-3007, path traversal), cert-manager dependency vuln. Need triage + patch schedule.

julia: Thanks. Do we have CVSS scores + exploit maturity?

sam: CVSS: kubelet 7.8, etcd 9.1, ingress 6.5, cert-manager dep 5.4. etct has PoC in the wild — mark as high.

alex: agree etcd is P0. We should plan hotfix for etcd asap. Kubelet we can bundle in the next maintenance window unless exploit escalates.

matt: +1. Who owns the etcd hotfix build/validation? platform-team? @lia?

lia: I can take lead on etcd. Will need a quick matrix: supported versions, backports, and test plan for restores. Also need certs for the canary cluster.

sam: lia — assign you. alex can help with rollout automation. Julia, can you own RBAC impact review and KMS integration notes for cert-manager?

julia: On it. Initial notes: cert-manager currently stores ACME private keys in secrets; we should evaluate envelope-encrypting them with KMS (AWS KMS/HSM) before rolling updates. That may require ServiceAccount + RBAC changes for the KMS-sidecar if we add one.

alex: For ingress, we should pin the controller image to digest and push a chart update to charts/private-ingress repo. Minimal change — image bump & CVE patch. Will run canary in staging-2 first.

sam: Proposed schedule: 
- T+24h: etcd hotfix PR + canary cluster apply (lia)
- T+48–72h: ingress image bump + helm chart rollout (alex)
- T+7d: kubelet minor upgrade during maintenance window
- T+10d: cert-manager dependency follow-up + KMS integration plan (julia)

matt: Slack thread for platform ops to block maintenance windows? I can open a short ops-ticket. Also we need audit logging changes: increase apiserver audit retention to 90d and ensure etcd write-ahead logs captured.

lia: For etcd canary, I'll run these checks: snapshot restore, auth-enabled path checks, heavy write load simulation, and metrics baseline. Will post results here.

julia: RBAC checklist I’ll run: 1) serviceAccount used by cert-manager needs kms:Encrypt,Decrypt policy on KMS envelope key; 2) add an explicit role for secret access limited to cert-manager namespace; 3) patch Helm values to use projected serviceAccount token when talking to KMS.

alex: Example helm values snippet I’ll include in PR: ```yaml
image:
  repository: quay.io/nginx-ingress/controller
  digest: sha256:REPLACEME
replicaCount: 2
```

sam: Security tests: add automated smoke tests into our infra repo: verify etcd endpoints not writable anonymously, kubelet read-only port disabled, ingress path traversal fuzzing quick-run. Make them gate for the PR.

matt: I'll add audit probes to the QA pipeline. Also flagging deployment slack channel for on-call during canaries.

lia: Started canary apply to staging-canary-3. Will report at 1776001400 after basic checks.

sec-bot: vuln-triage: CVE-2026-2002 (etcd) flagged HIGH, exploit status: ACTIVE. Auto-created ticket SEC-8721.

sam: Good. Next steps: lia+alex do hotfix canary, julia prepare RBAC+KMS plan and PR template, matt open ops block and add audit probes, I'll coordinate release notes and customer comms.

julia: One more thing — cert-manager version pin list and chart changes will be a separate PR. We should avoid mixing KMS integration into the initial patch to reduce risk. KMS can be v2 sprint.

sam: Agreed. Split into "patch sprint" (etcd+ingress+kubelet) vs "integration sprint" (KMS+RBAC+cert-manager).

lia: Canary update: etcd snapshot/restore ✅, auth checks ✅, WAL baseline within expected. No regressions so far. Posting logs in the ticket.

alex: ingress chart PR opened: PR #412 — pinned digest and added tests. tagging @matt for canary scheduling.

matt: Ops ticket OPEN: OP-2309 — maintenance windows reserved for T+4 and T+7. Added on-call rota.

sam: Perfect. I'll compile a short advisory for sales/CS: include affected components, mitigations, ETA for full rollout.

julia: I'll draft RBAC doc and KMS integration RFC in docs/sec/kms-cert-manager.md and link from PR.

sam: Thanks all. Leave any blockers here. :thumbsup:
